title: SkySong – Sheet Music Library & Rehearsal Player
description: A full-featured, interactive sheet music library and rehearsal player. Designed and built using React/JavaScript, the tool demonstrated a product impact by reducing individual part learning time by 80% during beta testing. Includes a secure admin portal with role-based access control.

title: Kaylee Ulep Professional Portfolio
description: This dedicated portfolio was built with Next.js 14 (App Router) to ensure a fast, highly scannable experience for recruiters. Features clean, component-driven architecture, and a fully responsive, mobile-first design.

title: Luminary — Best Overall Project Winner
description: Architected focus timers and app lifecycle features in SwiftUI, implementing productivity workflows with visual progress rewards. Developed SwiftUI interfaces from designer mockups and collaborated with backend engineers to integrate APIs and support application features.

title: MatchMission — Nonprofit Matching Platform
description: A full-stack nonprofit platform built during a Tech Developer internship with Sponsors for Educational Opportunity (SEO), winner of SEO's Best Integration and Architecture Award. Led frontend development and collaborated on REST API integration between a Flask backend and a React/TypeScript client.
